svg.aria-label: Station Junbiki, sequenced staging: a traversing lift on a floor track along the front of a three-level gravity flow rack takes each oiled block off the infeed from the Spray Booth, travels to the lane of its delivery lot, raises it to the top level and runs it in. The lanes fall gently away from the lift, so the blocks roll down past braking rollers to queue at the far end, where complete lots go out to the truck.
